response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS risk_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(risk_count) AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(t.risk_count) AS avg_above_count, AVG(t.risk_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM type_counts AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE t.risk_count > a.avg_count;
